errors.evidence: The description does not state the topic of the survey question, which is about whether waste from construction, renovation, and demolition could be utilized more effectively.
The pie chart visually displays only three sectors with non-zero values (47.6%, 33.3%, and 19%).

errors.text_span: оцветени в синьо, жълто, зелено и синьо
errors.evidence: The colors of the three visible sectors are blue, red, and orange. The description fails to mention the red sector and hallucinates a green sector.
The largest blue sector (47.6%) corresponds to the legend item "Напълно съм съгласен" (Completely agree), not "Изобщо не съм съгласен" (Completely disagree).

errors.text_span: жълт сектор, обозначен като "Не съм съгласен" и представлява 19% от отговорите
errors.evidence: The sector with 19% is orange (described as yellow), but its label according to the legend is "Не съм сигурен" (Not sure), not "Не съм съгласен" (Disagree).

errors.text_span: Третият сектор е зелен, обозначен като "Не съм сигурен" и представлява 19% от отговорите.
errors.evidence: There is no green sector in the pie chart. The description invents this sector and incorrectly assigns attributes that belong to the orange sector.

errors.text_span: най-малкият сектор е синьо-зелен, обозначен като "Съгласен съм" и представлява 33,3% от отговорите
errors.evidence: The chart does not contain a blue-green sector. The sector with the value 33.3% is red. Additionally, this is not the smallest sector; the 19% sector is the smallest.
A legend is clearly visible on the right side of the pie chart, mapping colors to categories.
